spec.description: Side-by-side L1 bid/ask/mid, depth volume, spread, trades, and day_range. QuestDB column `symbol` is ISIN (IRTK…). Variables pass ISIN values. spec.title: A · L1 price + day range
spec.description: L1 bid/ask/mid, last trade, day_range_min/max. Symbol = $symbol_a.

spec.rawSql:
WITH ob AS (
  SELECT timestamp,
    avg(CASE WHEN side = 'bid' THEN price END) AS bid,
    avg(CASE WHEN side = 'ask' THEN price END) AS ask,
    (avg(CASE WHEN side = 'bid' THEN price END)
      + avg(CASE WHEN side = 'ask' THEN price END)) / 2 AS mid
  FROM orderbook_historical
  WHERE symbol = '${symbol_a}'
    AND level = '1'
    AND is_deleted = false
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND hour(timestamp) >= 12 AND hour(timestamp) < 18
  SAMPLE BY ${bucket} ALIGN TO CALENDAR
),
dr AS (
  SELECT timestamp, day_range_min, day_range_max
  FROM day_range_historical
  WHERE symbol = '${symbol_a}' AND is_deleted = false
),
tr AS (
  SELECT timestamp, last(price) AS last_px
  FROM trades_historical
  WHERE symbol = '${symbol_a}'
    AND is_deleted = false
    AND canceled = false
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND hour(timestamp) >= 12 AND hour(timestamp) < 18
  SAMPLE BY ${bucket} ALIGN TO CALENDAR
)
SELECT ob.timestamp AS time,
  ob.bid, ob.ask, ob.mid, tr.last_px,
  dr.day_range_min, dr.day_range_max
FROM ob
ASOF JOIN dr
ASOF JOIN tr;

spec.title: A · L1 volume (bid up / ask down)
spec.description: Best-bid size positive; best-ask size negated. Symbol = $symbol_a.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN side = 'bid' THEN volume END) AS bid_vol,
  -avg(CASE WHEN side = 'ask' THEN volume END) AS ask_vol_neg
FROM orderbook_historical
WHERE symbol = '${symbol_a}'
  AND level = '1'
  AND is_deleted = false
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND hour(timestamp) >= 12 AND hour(timestamp) < 18
SAMPLE BY ${bucket} ALIGN TO CALENDAR;

spec.title: B · L1 volume (bid up / ask down)
spec.description: Best-bid size positive; best-ask size negated. Symbol = $symbol_b.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN side = 'bid' THEN volume END) AS bid_vol,
  -avg(CASE WHEN side = 'ask' THEN volume END) AS ask_vol_neg
FROM orderbook_historical
WHERE symbol = '${symbol_b}'
  AND level = '1'
  AND is_deleted = false
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND hour(timestamp) >= 12 AND hour(timestamp) < 18
SAMPLE BY ${bucket} ALIGN TO CALENDAR;

SELECT timestamp AS time,
  10000.0 * (avg(CASE WHEN side = 'ask' THEN price END)
    - avg(CASE WHEN side = 'bid' THEN price END))
    / nullif(
      (avg(CASE WHEN side = 'bid' THEN price END)
        + avg(CASE WHEN side = 'ask' THEN price END)) / 2, 0) AS spread_bps
FROM orderbook_historical
WHERE symbol = '${symbol_a}'
  AND level = '1'
  AND is_deleted = false
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND hour(timestamp) >= 12 AND hour(timestamp) < 18
SAMPLE BY ${bucket} ALIGN TO CALENDAR;

SELECT timestamp AS time,
  10000.0 * (avg(CASE WHEN side = 'ask' THEN price END)
    - avg(CASE WHEN side = 'bid' THEN price END))
    / nullif(
      (avg(CASE WHEN side = 'bid' THEN price END)
        + avg(CASE WHEN side = 'ask' THEN price END)) / 2, 0) AS spread_bps
FROM orderbook_historical
WHERE symbol = '${symbol_b}'
  AND level = '1'
  AND is_deleted = false
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

spec.title: Compare · mid % from window open
spec.description: Each mid indexed to its first in-window value. A = $symbol_a, B = $symbol_b.

spec.rawSql:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT timestamp,
    (avg(CASE WHEN side = 'bid' THEN price END)
      + avg(CASE WHEN side = 'ask' THEN price END)) / 2 AS mid
  FROM orderbook_historical
  WHERE symbol = '$symbol_a'
    AND level = '1' AND is_deleted = false
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND hour(timestamp) >= 12 AND hour(timestamp) < 18
  SAMPLE BY ${bucket} ALIGN TO CALENDAR
),
b AS (
  SELECT timestamp,
    (avg(CASE WHEN side = 'bid' THEN price END)
      + avg(CASE WHEN side = 'ask' THEN price END)) / 2 AS mid
  FROM orderbook_historical
  WHERE symbol = '$symbol_b'
    AND level = '1' AND is_deleted = false
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND hour(timestamp) >= 12 AND hour(timestamp) < 18
  SAMPLE BY ${bucket} ALIGN TO CALENDAR
),
a0 AS (SELECT first(mid) AS m0 FROM a),
b0 AS (SELECT first(mid) AS m0 FROM b)
SELECT a.timestamp AS time,
  100.0 * (a.mid / a0.m0 - 1) AS mid_pct_a,
  100.0 * (b.mid / b0.m0 - 1) AS mid_pct_b
FROM a
JOIN b ON a.timestamp = b.timestamp
CROSS JOIN a0
CROSS JOIN b0;
